xar_current_descendant_score_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { is_alive = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:xar_score_preview_dyn
				exists = dynasty
				dynasty = { this = scope:xar_score_preview_dyn }
			}
			add = 0.1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:xar_score_preview_house
				exists = house
				house = { this = scope:xar_score_preview_house }
			}
			add = 0.1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_hegemony }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
			add = 5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
			add = 2.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy }
			add = 1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county }
			add = 0.25
		}
	}
}

xar_current_score_value = {
	value = xar_current_score_base_value
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:xa_score_basis = 1 }
		subtract = { value = global_var:xa_score_baseline }
		min = 0
	}

	# Each declined blessing session removes 1.00 percent; never below zero.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:xa_bless_reject_count > 0 }
		multiply = {
			value = 1
			subtract = { value = global_var:xa_bless_reject_count multiply = 0.01 }
			min = 0
		}
	}
}
